text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where is this...??? I could've sworn
I was just on the track a moment ago...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright, nobody's here.
I should be able to experiment to my heart's content."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Tachyon-san?!
D-Digitan is right here, though...?
I'm so sorry if I'm intruding!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? An abnormal electrostatic reading on the sensor...
There shouldn't be any organisms nearby capable of such interference.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Tachyon-saaaan??
...Wait, you can't see me!!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, you're joking, right...?
Uh, wait, wait, wait, wait...?!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
...I-I don't really get it, but does this mean
I can watch my fave as much as I want without getting in the way!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
There's no time to dawdle!!
Time to go watch my fave right this instaannnt!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah~! What is this~~!!!
My legs feel so light! Wait, I'm floating...?!
Whoaa!! Am I running in the air~~~?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I danced it all out...!
The flame of muscles burns in my heart like hell, and oxygen and fat blaze around me...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! She really can't see me...!
To think I can avoid getting in the way of my concentrated fave...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hum-hum~♪ Drink and be drunk~♪
An Umamusume in tears~♪ Running up north, hum-hum-hum~♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Kufufu, humming all by yourself in the classroom after school...
Not quite remembering the lyrics is so adorbz! You win, hands down!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nghaaahhh! Is this the best or what~~~?! Now, which Umamusume-chan should I—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh... Trainer?!
Where on earth are we...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right... An Umamusume passing by was just
so cute that I started panting, and then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(C-Could it be, it was so precious she fainted...
and had an out-of-body experience, or something...?!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Haaah, are you serious...!
I just had the best experience ever.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(And that sensation when I ran through the sky...
Right, if I can apply that to my races...!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Don't you worry.
Trainer, just look forward
to our next race!
